primitives.name: Per-Play TrueSkill Ratings
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## BUILD 7 — Per-play TrueSkill player ratings (SamuelLachance, open source) His result: 14-feature stack with 11v11 per-play TrueSkill ratings beats team Elo alone (test log-loss 0.61919 vs plain Elo 0.63984 vs closing line ~0.609).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mu_i^{(t)}': "Player i's TrueSkill mean at time t (dimensionless)", '\\sigma_i^{(t)}': "Player i's TrueSkill standard deviation at time t (dimensionless)", 'K(t)': 'Kalman gain at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each play is modeled as a contest between 11v11 players; player ratings follow Gaussian distributions; EPA outcomes are bucketed into win/draw/loss.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a player is benched or inactive, their \sigma increases due to lack of observation.

layer2.mapping: Player-level TrueSkill updates inform team strength aggregation via summed mu values, enabling probabilistic team comparisons.
layer2.telemetry: Log-loss improvement over Elo baseline; consistency of rank changes for active vs inactive players.

primitives.name: Weekly QB Kalman Fusion
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Weekly QB Kalman fusion: fuse the QB's TrueSkill mu with the prior week's via a Kalman update step (treat weekly observed QB EPA as the measurement).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\mu_{QB}^{(t)}': "Quarterback's TrueSkill mean at time t (dimensionless)", 'EPA_{QB}^{(t)}': 'Observed EPA for QB at time t (yards)', 'K(t)': 'Kalman gain at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: QB EPA is a reliable proxy for performance; Kalman filter assumes linear dynamics and Gaussian noise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If QB is inactive or substituted, the Kalman update halts until reobservation.

layer2.mapping: Enables temporal smoothing of QB performance by blending prior estimates with new EPA observations.
layer2.telemetry: Reduction in variance of QB rating over time; alignment of predicted EPA with actual outcomes.

primitives.assumptions: Efficiency is inversely related to opponent strength; iterative adjustment converges under bounded variance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a team faces predominantly weak opponents, SoS adjustment lowers their apparent efficiency.

layer2.telemetry: Convergence of iteration within 100 steps; difference in efficiency ranking before and after adjustment.

reasoning_traces.think:
Per-play TrueSkill ratings model each NFL play as a contest between 11 offensive and 11 defensive players, updating individual player ratings using Gaussian belief propagation. The update rule integrates EPA outcomes into a probabilistic framework, where mu represents skill level and sigma captures uncertainty. Team strength emerges as the sum of starter mu values, enabling team-level comparisons. Weekly QB Kalman fusion refines quarterback skill estimates by blending prior TrueSkill means with observed EPA, treating EPA as noisy measurements. This temporal smoothing improves forecast stability. SoS-adjusted efficiency corrects raw EPA metrics for opponent strength, solving iteratively to ensure transitivity and fairness. These primitives form a modular system where player-level updates feed into team aggregates, which in turn inform higher-order features like dynamic Elo and efficiency differentials. Each component maintains mathematical consistency and empirical verifiability through test assertions such as rank consistency and convergence behavior.
